test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which district of Kerala did a major landslide occur in July 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wayanad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Reports indicate that extremely heavy rainfall in late July 2024 caused catastrophic landslides and flooding, particularly affecting Wayanad district in Kerala.
 
• There are reports of heavy rainfall also affecting Idukki district, and also red alerts being issued for Idukki.
 
• Specifically the Wayanad landslide was very severe, with many deaths and much distruction.
 
• The landslides in Wayanad occurred in areas including Punjirimattom, Mundakkai, Chooralmala, and Vellarimala villages in Meppadi panchayat, Vythiri taluk.
 
• The heavy rains triggered flash floods and multiple landslides on the steep slopes in these areas.
 
• The scale of the disaster in Wayanad led to significant rescue and relief efforts, involving various agencies.
 
• The event resulted in substantial loss of life, property damage, and displacement of residents.
 
• The geographical terrain of Wayanad, characterized by steep slopes and heavy rainfall, makes it vulnerable to landslides.
 
• Heavy rain fall through out the western ghats, causes many land slides, that is why many districts were placed on red alert.
 
• The heavy rainfall caused the collapse of hillsides, leading to the destruction of villages below.
 
• Rescue operations were hindered by damaged roads and bridges, making access to affected areas difficult.
 
• The disaster prompted the deployment of personnel from the National Disaster Response Force (NDRF), Army, Air Force, Navy, and other emergency services.
 
• The Kerala government provided relief camps for displaced residents.
 
• Financial assistance and rehabilitation efforts were initiated for the affected communities.
 
• The event highlighted the vulnerability of the region to climate-related disasters.
 
• The landslides caused significant damage to infrastructure, including roads, bridges, and buildings.
 
• Agricultural lands were also heavily impacted by the landslides.
 
• The disaster resulted in the loss of livestock and wildlife.
 
• The event underscored the need for improved disaster preparedness and mitigation measures.
 
• The impact of the landslide was widely reported in national and international media.
 
• There were great efforts made to provide medical assistance to those injured.
